introHtml: Insulated nursing scrubs provide essential warmth for healthcare professionals working in cold environments, such as surgical suites or outdoor clinics. Unlike standard scrubs, these feature thermal lining to maintain body heat without sacrificing mobility. Bulk orders allow your team to stay comfortable while displaying your facility logo through embroidery or heat transfer. Perfect for hospitals, urgent care centers, and nursing schools needing branded apparel that performs.
